RE-DERIVED AT STAGE 7. This was DOWNSTREAM / UNKNOWN / LOW on tier 1b, and the 1b came from a single hand-written row in clinical_facts.yaml asserting that anti-TNF therapy does not resolve acne. That claim was already known to be inverted (step zero found ~100 observational patients suggesting it helps) and the file is retired, so the row is gone and nothing retrieved replaces it: no drug's mechanism record names TNF for acne. The case now abstains on literature alone. THIS IS THE RETIREMENT WORKING, not a regression. It is also the clearest single illustration of what the curated file was doing: supplying a confident tier 1 layer from one unverified sentence.

RE-DERIVED TWICE, AND THE HISTORY IS THE POINT. Written as a prediction of DOWNSTREAM/ACTIONABLE before the graph existed. The first build returned UNKNOWN and the expectation was changed to assert that refusal, because the model was reaching benefit by subtracting per-arm counts, which the goal statement forbids. Enforcing that prohibition in the validator removed those reads. What remains is legitimate: NCT01616654 publishes p=0.040 on a co-primary and NCT04856904 publishes p<0.0001 with a confidence interval, so trifarotene does have readable benefit in acne. The original prediction was right for reasons the first two runs could not show. THIS IS THE ONE CASE WHOSE VERDICT IS NOT REPRODUCIBLE: 75 trials go to the model and it has returned UNKNOWN on some runs. Expect this case to go red occasionally. See DEBT.md.
